name: gsd-status-mod
description: A Claude Code mod for GSD projects: a live pane (roadmap, agent tree with forks, cost and context, work streams, session log, pace and fit forecast, timeline, trends, a markdown reader) plus a status band, a next-action hint and /gsd-status, read from .planning/.

openOnStart.title: Open the pane on start
openOnStart.description: Open the live GSD pane when a session starts in a GSD project. /gsd-board opens it later either way.

toasts.title: Toast notices
toasts.description: Short notices when an agent runs far over its usual time, when the rest of a phase will not fit the 5-hour window, or when STATE.md drifts.
